title: Adverbs of Manner & Degree: Action Precision & Nuance Modifiers
subtitle: CEFR B1–B2 • Verb Modification (-ly) & Intensity Gradation

topics.title: 1. Adverbs of Manner (How an Action Happens)
topics.subtitle: Modifying Verbs with Precision (-ly Forms)
topics.explanation: Kata keterangan cara (quickly, smoothly, accurately, reliably) menjelaskan BAGAIMANA sebuah tindakan dilakukan. Dibentuk dengan menambahkan '-ly' pada kata sifat dan diletakkan setelah kata kerja atau objek.
topics.rationale: Adjective menjelaskan BENDA (a fast server), sedangkan Adverb menjelaskan AKSI (the server responds fast / quickly). Membedakan keduanya menjaga akurasi tata bahasa profesional.

formulas.pattern: Subject + Aux + not + Verb + (Object) + [Adverb of Manner]

conditionalExamples.positive: The new caching layer handles concurrent requests smoothly.
conditionalExamples.negative: The legacy script didn't parse edge cases accurately.
conditionalExamples.question: Did the candidate explain their problem-solving process clearly?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Jangan pernah menaruh adverb di antara kata kerja dan objeknya (*handles smoothly requests).

xrayTokens.nuance: Diletakkan di akhir setelah objek 'concurrent requests'

specialExceptions.title: Good (Adjective) vs. Well (Adverb) & Flat Adverbs
specialExceptions.explanation: 'Good' adalah kata sifat, bentuk adverb-nya adalah 'well'. Sementara 'fast', 'hard', dan 'late' memiliki bentuk yang sama untuk adjective maupun adverb.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: She speaks English very good and works hardly.
specialExceptions.correctExample: She speaks English very well and works hard. ('Hardly' berarti hampir tidak!)

tipsAndTricks: Waspadai jebakan makna ganda: 'work hard' = bekerja keras, sedangkan 'hardly work' = hampir tidak bekerja.

topics.title: 2. Adverbs of Degree (Fairly, Quite, Extremely, Enough)
topics.subtitle: Calibrating Intensity Before Adjectives & Adverbs
topics.explanation: Digunakan untuk mengatur tingkat intensitas suatu sifat atau tindakan—mulai dari level sedang (fairly, quite, rather) hingga ekstrem (extremely, remarkably, significantly)—serta batas kecukupan (too vs. enough).
topics.rationale: Di level B1–B2, menghindari kata 'very' yang berulang dan menggantinya dengan pengukur intensitas yang presisi membuat komunikasi terdengar jauh lebih artikulatif.

formulas.pattern: S + Be + [quite / fairly / significantly] + Adj  |  S + Be + Adj + enough
S + Be + not + Adj + enough  |  S + Be + too + Adj + to + V1
Is + S + Adj + enough + to + V1?

conditionalExamples.positive: The bundle size is significantly smaller and fast enough for mobile users.
conditionalExamples.negative: The current bandwidth isn't stable enough for 4K streaming.
conditionalExamples.question: Is the documentation clear enough for new contributors?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: 'Too + Adj' bermakna negatif (berlebihan sehingga gagal), sedangkan 'Adj + enough' bermakna positif (memenuhi syarat).

specialExceptions.title: Posisi 'Enough': Sebelum Noun, Setelah Adjective
specialExceptions.explanation: 'Enough' berdiri di DEPAN kata benda (enough time), tetapi di BELAKANG kata sifat (strong enough).
specialExceptions.wrongExample: We don't have time enough, and the server isn't enough fast.
specialExceptions.correctExample: We don't have enough time, and the server isn't fast enough.

tipsAndTricks: Ganti 'very important' dengan 'crucial/essential', dan 'very fast' dengan 'remarkably fast' untuk meningkatkan kualitas kosakata B2.

scenario.interlocutor: Product Manager bertanya apakah performa aplikasi sudah layak rilis
scenario.intent: Menyatakan bahwa performa sudah memenuhi standar menggunakan 'enough'.

practiceQuiz.question: Pilih kalimat dengan urutan kata yang benar:

options.text: The response time is enough fast for production.
The response time is fast enough for production.
The response time is too fast enough for production.

deepExplanation.whyCorrect: 'Enough' wajib diletakkan setelah kata sifat ('fast enough').
deepExplanation.whyOthersFail: Opsi A menaruh 'enough' sebelum adjective, dan Opsi C menggabungkan 'too' dan 'enough' secara keliru.
deepExplanation.realLifeHack: Ingat pasangan kontras: 'too slow' (terlalu lambat) vs. 'fast enough' (cukup cepat).
